messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for tool-calls to tenant mariner-enterprise on pool us-west-2-dedicated-12. Metric: parser_errors 5xx spike. Thread root: 1715001234

anne: seeing lots of 'unexpected token after chunk boundary' in the logs for paged responses. customer reports truncated exports.

sam: oncall here — what's the customer impact? throttles or OOMs?

anne: impact ~18% of requests for that tenant are returning truncated paged responses -> client 500s. affects batch export jobs. CS alerted (cc @luis).

luis: mariner CS — they said exported transcripts are missing chunks, they've paused large jobs. Very sensitive data.

sam: ok. immediate plan: 1) route new traffic to fallback pool 2) push parser tolerant shim 3) keep customer throttled. @irene can runtime toggle parser tolerant?

irene: yes. I can enable a tolerant parser_mode that strips incomplete trailing chunks and attempts best-effort reassembly. I'll canary on one host in the dedicated pool. ETA ~20m. Command I'm going to run: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/runtime/config 
  -d '{"tenant":"mariner-enterprise","parser_mode":"tolerant"}'
```

sam: ops — also add a routing fallback to general-lowlatency pool for this tenant. quick cli I ran: 
```
rbac route add --tenant mariner-enterprise --from pool:us-west-2-dedicated-12 --to pool:general-lowlatency --policy fallback
```
(rolling now)

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started on us-west-2-dedicated-host-7 for parser-shim (rev sha:aa11bb).

anne: adding log filters and lowering alert thresholds so we can watch for regressions.

oncall (sam): setting incident Sev=P1. Notifying account team and legal per enterprise SLA. @luis can you ask the customer to throttle to 10% for 30m?

luis: told them to throttle to 10% and pause remaining jobs. They're holding for our update.

irene: canary results so far: parser_errors on host-7 dropped 18% -> 2%. No obvious side-effects. Rolling to 3 more hosts now.

sam: routing change is live, about 60% of new requests are going to the fallback pool. latency +~20ms but errors dropping sharply.

anne: observing paged-responses that previously failed now succeeding. Found one edge case: multi-chunk JSON with embedded escaped newlines still trips older parser. Captured sample for regression.

irene: will file a proper unit test and patch. PR #4762 created, includes sample from logs and test case. Full runtime release may be required if the canary needs expansion.

sam: owners: anne -> incident writeup, irene -> runtime patch + PR, luis -> customer comms. Keep P1 until 2 hours of stable low-error and customer confirms.

luis: customer says partial resume looks good, still monitoring. thanks team. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: Incident update: error rate down to 1.3%, reroute in effect. Next automated update in 30m.

anne: will start post-incident notes and include the captured sample in the regression suite. Closing plan: full runtime patch rollout tomorrow during maintenance window unless further failures seen.
